summary: GD Culture Group Ltd filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $300,000,000 of its common stock through sales agent Univest Securities LLC. Shares trade on Nasdaq under symbol GDC; closing price on April 28, 2026 was $3.97. Sales will be made under Rule 415 in at-the-market transactions. The agent receives a 3.5% placement fee. The filing is a routine shelf takedown for capital raising, not a special situation event. No special-situation event is triggered.
